title: Eggs
instructions: Remove seeds from peppers and pour boiling water over them. Let stand till cold. Chop fine the onions,  peppers, and tomatoes, and cook five minutes in the butter. Add parsley, and season highly with salt and pepper. Use this sauce to serve over the eggs fried.
